map.根据目标合金元素含量(Cr/Ni/Mo等)，计算各铁合金原料加入量，支持回收率修: Compute the amount of each ferroalloy raw material to add from the target element content (Cr/Ni/Mo and so on), with recovery correction.
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：delta÷(e.rawPct÷100×e.reco: Core formula (over the input variables): delta ÷ (e.rawPct÷100 × e.recovery÷100); W × (e.target − initPct) ÷ 100
map.钢液中元素初始含量 (%): Initial Element Content in the Steel (%)
map.目标元素与原料配比: Target Element to Raw Material Ratio
map.某元素需增量 ΔM = W × (目标含量 − 初始含量) / 100 (t): The increment for an element ΔM = W × (target content − initial content) / 100 (t)
map.原料加入量 = ΔM / (原料合金含量 × 回收率): Raw material addition = ΔM ÷ (raw material alloy content × recovery)
map.5t 钢液需增 Cr 至 18%，原料为高碳铬铁(含Cr 60%，回收率 95%: For 5t of steel needing Cr raised to 18%, with high-carbon ferrochrome as the raw material (60% Cr, 95% recovery), addition = 5×18% ÷ (60%×95%) ≈ 1.58 t.
map.注：本工具为理论估算，未考虑原料带入的碳/磷等副作用及温度影响。: Note: this tool is a theoretical estimate and does not consider side effects such as carbon or phosphorus introduced by the raw material, or temperature effects.
map.反算需加入的原料合金质量，用于熔炼配料单。: from the target to get the raw material mass to add, for the melting charge sheet.
map.考虑原料合金含量与冶炼回收率，避免投入不足导致成分偏低。: Account for raw material alloy content and smelting recovery to avoid under-charging leading to a low composition.
map.多元素目标时逐元素分别反算，取各原料加入量的最大值统筹投料。: With multi-element targets, back-calculate each element separately and take the largest of the raw material additions for coordinated charging.
map.需补元素质量 ΔM = W × (目标含量 − 初始含量) / 100（W 为钢: Element mass to add ΔM = W × (target content − initial content) / 100 (W is the molten steel mass). Raw material addition = ΔM ÷ (raw material alloy content × recovery). Recovery reflects the actual yield of that element in smelting and is below 1 for easily oxidised elements.
map.5 t 钢液目标 Cr 18%（初始可忽略），用高碳铬铁（含 Cr 60%、回收: For 5 t of steel targeting Cr 18% (initial negligible) with high-carbon ferrochrome (60% Cr, 95% recovery): ΔM = 5000×(18−0)/100 = 900 kg; addition = 900 ÷ (0.60×0.95) = 900 ÷ 0.57 ≈ 1579 kg ≈ 1.58 t. So about 1.58 t of high-carbon ferrochrome is needed to make up the Cr.
map.按炉型与元素氧化倾向取经验值（如 Cr 95%、Si 85%、Mn 80% 量级: Take empirical values based on furnace type and oxidation tendency (of the order Cr 95%, Si 85%, Mn 80%) and adjust from the furnace-side assay. Choosing too low leads to under-charging and a low composition.
map.初始含量不能忽略时？: What if the initial content cannot be ignored?
map.用公式中的 (目标−初始)；若钢液已含部分 Cr，只需补差额，加入量相应减少，避: Use (target − initial) in the formula. If the steel already contains some Cr, only the difference needs topping up and the addition drops accordingly, avoiding over-alloying.
